name: @gcu/patchbay
description: Eurorack-style reactive dataflow surface for Auditable Works. Modules with knobs/jacks/displays; patch cables are real reactive dependencies. SDK + sideact-backed engine + canvas rack.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia

auditable.exampleOf: works-contribution-registry — a self-contained surface whose engine ships as index.js (→ /lib/@gcu/patchbay/source); the surface imports @gcu/patchbay from its own source and pulls @gcu/sideact via gcu.requires.
